paragraph: Helga Duffy lives in an assisted-living facility where the staff paid attention to what sparked her interest. Three months ago, her niece watched another elderly woman go wing-walking, and the staff encouraged Helga to try it herself. This week, Guinness World Records made it official: at ninety-nine, she is now the world's oldest wing-walker. She was strapped to the top of a small plane at Rendcomb Airfield.
